children: Canada data management firm's Q3 revenue rose 18% yr/yr, driven by North American drilling gains
Q3 adjusted EBITDA beat analyst expectations
Net income attributable to Pason rose 51% yr/yr
Pason expects continued strength in North American Drilling in coming quarters as industry activity rises
Company anticipates 2026 capital expenditures near the lower end of the C$60-70 mln range
Pason expects 2027 capital expenditures of C$65-75 mln to support activity growth and technology transition
NORTH AMERICAN DRILLING - Revenue rose 16% to C$80.0 mln as industry activity increased 11% and revenue per industry day reached a record C$1,125
SOLAR AND ENERGY STORAGE - Significant increase in control system deliveries boosted revenue in the segment
COMPLETIONS SEGMENT WEAKNESS - Revenue declined due to schedule gaps in customer activity, resulting in fewer active jobs
